relations.text: 北米での装置と消耗品の販売代理契約をAvantorと締結(2024年11月)
relations.text_en: Signed a North American distribution agreement with Avantor (Nov 2024)

source.label: Quantum-Si 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Further, in November 2024 we announced a North American distribution agreement with Avantor to distribute the Platinum Pro and related consumables.

companies.name: エスタブリッシュメント・ラブズ

relations.text: 医療用シリコーン(NuSil)をAvantorから調達(唯一の供給元)
relations.text_en: Sources NuSil medical-grade silicone from Avantor, a sole-source supplier

source.label: Establishment Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In particular, we obtain NuSil brand medical-grade silicone from Avantor, Inc. (formerly NuSil Technology LLC), or Avantor, which is a sole-source supplier of such products to the majority of the silicone breast implant industry.

relations.text: CareDxが10-Kで、Avantorを仕入れ先の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: CareDx names Avantor among its suppliers

source.label: CareDx 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We do not have guaranteed supply agreements with Thermo Fisher, Becton, Dickinson and Company or Avantor, which exposes us to the risk that these suppliers may choose to discontinue doing business with us at any time.

relations.text: Corningが10-Kで、ライフサイエンス製品の主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Corning names Avantor among principal life sciences competitors

source.label: Corning 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Avantor, Inc., Greiner AG, Eppendorf SE, Sarstedt AG & Co.

relations.text: Alpha Pro Techが10-Kで、元の最大の販売代理店VWRを主な競合に挙げる

source.label: Alpha Pro Tech 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors in the industrial and cleanroom market are our former largest distributor, VWR International, LLC, Kimberly-Clark Corporation, 3M Company, Kappler, Inc
